title: Mera sehriyaan waala Akbar
body:
Mera sehriyaan waala Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Zakhm dil kay dikhaaoon maen kaisay (x2)
Tera laasha utthaoon maen kaisay
Akbar mera sehriyaan waala Akbar (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Lashay Akbar pey Shaah jab pahoonchay
Dil ko haathon sey thaam kar bolay
Teri furqath ney aye Ali Akbar
Aag dil mein meray lagadee hae
Aag dil ki bhujaoon maen kaisay (x2)
